methodologyNotes: Roster covers thirteen weighted vests / plate carriers spanning budget adjustable-shot vests (CAP Barbell, ZFOsports, Cross101, MiR), modular Olympic-plate systems (Kensui EZ-Vest), tactical plate carriers rated by user-supplied plates (5.11 TacTec, Rogue Plate Carrier, GORUCK Achilles), a stretch-fabric fixed-plate vest (Hyperwear Hyper Vest PRO), and a big-box adjustable line (Titan Fitness); this session's WebSearch budget was exhausted almost immediately and WebFetch access to Amazon, Walmart, Bing, and DuckDuckGo was heavily rate-limited (429/500/403 responses) partway through research, so verification depth varies by entry and is stated per product in its provenance field rather than assumed uniform. Directly fetched and confirmed via live manufacturer/retailer page content: Hyperwear (hyperwear.com), 5.11 Tactical (511tactical.com), Rogue Fitness (roguefitness.com), Kensui (kensui.com), all four CAP Barbell SKUs (capbarbell.com), and GORUCK (goruck.com, category-level confirmation of the Achilles vest's 20/30 lb options and $195 starting price). ZFOsports and Cross101 URLs were confirmed to exist via live search-index results (title and ASIN matched) but the Amazon product pages themselves returned server errors on direct fetch, so several specs for those two are left null rather than guessed. MiR's Amazon page loaded far enough to confirm the exact title and URL are real; supporting specs (fabric, weight material) come from a corroborating Walmart cross-listing snippet rather than the Amazon page body. Titan Fitness's individual product catalog is JavaScript-rendered and not retrievable through available tooling this session; only its own buying-guide text (20-60 lb range, 2.5 lb increments) was recoverable, so SKU-level price/fabric/sizing are null. Three seed suggestions were dropped rather than published with unverifiable data: "Aduro Sport" (aduroproducts.com resolves but is a consumer-electronics brand with no weighted-vest product in its current catalog - no evidence a fitness sub-brand still exists), and "Empower 4-in-1" / "Prodigen 16lb" / "Box Tactical" (no live-searchable or fetchable real product page could be located for any of the three under available tooling, unlike ZFOsports/Cross101/MiR which did surface real, matching URLs). To reach the target roster size without fabricating sources, CAP Barbell's three additional real, distinctly-specced SKUs (40-150 lb range model, women's 30 lb, 40 lb camo) were added in their place, all confirmed on the same live-fetched capbarbell.com collection. accessedAt 2026-08-12 throughout.

products.name: Hyperwear Hyper Vest PRO Adjustable Weighted Vest
products.priceNote: Hyperwear.com listed price ('From $239.95', sale pricing at time of check); base 10 lb vest, final price varies by size and add-on weight

specs.adjustable_increments: modular ~2.25 oz (0.14 lb) steel weight plates added to build up total capacity
specs.sizing_fit: XS-XXL, sized to body via Hyperwear's size chart

products.provenance: Hyperwear's own product page (fetched live) confirms a 10 lb preloaded base vest, modular ~2.25 oz steel weight plates that build to ~42 lb total capacity, Zyflex two-way stretch fabric (described as more breathable than the neoprene-like ELITE model), XS-XXL sizing, and 'From $239.95' pricing. Reflective strips are documented only on the separate ELITE model, not the PRO, so reflective_trim is false here.

products.name: 5.11 Tactical TacTec Plate Carrier
products.priceNote: 511tactical.com marked-down price at time of check (list price $250.00)

specs.sizing_fit: S-XL shoulder straps; cummerbund fits 52-57 in. circumference

products.provenance: 5.11's own product page (fetched live) confirms 500D nylon construction with perforated mesh, S-XL adjustable straps with a 52-57 in. cummerbund, medium (12.5x9.5x2 in.) and large (13.25x10.25x2.25 in.) ESAPI-cut plate pockets compatible with Rogue Weight Vest Plates, and a $149.49 sale price (list $250.00). The carrier is not sold with or rated for a fixed weight - capacity depends entirely on whatever plates the buyer inserts - so total_weight_lb and max_weight_lb are left null rather than assumed. No reflective trim is documented.

products.name: Rogue Plate Carrier

specs.sizing_fit: S/M/L, velcro-adjustable shoulder straps and elastic rear belt

products.provenance: Rogue's own product page (fetched live) states a 40 lb maximum capacity (20 lb per plate, front and back) using Rogue USA Cast or Echo Weight Vest Plates, 1000D/500D Cordura construction with anti-chafe stretch-woven lining, S/M/L velcro-adjustable sizing, an unloaded vest weight of ~1.12 lb (medium), and a $165.00 price. No reflective trim is documented. Plates are sold separately, so weight_material/adjustable_increments (properties of the plates, not the carrier) are left null.

products.name: Kensui EZ-Vest Pro
products.priceNote: Kensui.com listed price for the Pro tier (Lite tier $99, Max tier $299 also offered on the same page)

specs.adjustable_increments: micro-loads in 2.5 lb increments using standard 1 in./2 in. Olympic weight plates
specs.sizing_fit: XS-3XL via adjustable shoulder and waist straps
specs.fabric: 1680D ballistic nylon exterior with removable, machine-washable padding

products.provenance: Kensui's own product page (fetched live) lists three tiers - Lite (80 lb max, fiberglass frame, $99), Pro (150 lb max, fiberglass frame with 6mm padding, $179), and Max (300 lb max, aircraft-grade aluminum frame with 8mm padding, $299) - all micro-loading with standard Olympic weight plates in 2.5 lb increments, 1680D ballistic nylon shells, and double-stitched webbing rated to 1,000 lb. The Pro tier is used as the representative entry. Plates are not included with purchase; empty vest weight is ~6.6 lb. total_weight_lb is left null since the vest ships unloaded and its loaded weight depends entirely on user-supplied plates.
